feeds.title: Rocket Gardens Blog
feeds.description: A Rocket Garden is a box brimming full of baby organic vegetable and herb plants. They make growing your own seasonal fresh food a pleasure. Our mission is to get everyone in the UK growing some of their own food.

feeds.title: Vertical Veg
feeds.description: Vertical Veg inspires and supports growing food in containers. I help you to transform a small space - like a balcony or patio - into an abundant container garden, filled with herbs, fruit, veg, beauty, and life. In the blog, you'll find tips on growing food in containers - what to grow, how to grow it, common challenges (and how to overcome them), how much it is possible to grow, and techniques to grow more.

feeds.title: Sustainable Market Farming
feeds.description: Targeted at serious growers, Sustainable Market Farming is a comprehensive manual for small-scale farmers raising organic crops sustainably on a few acres. Whether you are a beginning market grower or an established enterprise seeking to improve your skills, Sustainable Market Farming is an invaluable resource and a timely book for the maturing local agriculture movement.

feeds.title: Suttons Blog » Vegetable Growing
feeds.description: Suttons have been inspiring gardeners for over 200 years. Whatever your level of gardening experience, we have a shed-load of detailed growing guides, advice, monthly tasks, and more. Dig deep into our library of vegetable-growing guides for expert tips and advice. Visit now and you'll find all the help you need here at Sutton's.

feeds.title: Self-sufficient in Suburbia
feeds.description: In Self-sufficient in Suburbia, we write about how we grow our own food in a suburban village in the North East of England. Follow us as we keep up the battle to be self-sufficient.

feeds.title: Mr Fothergill's blog
feeds.description: Mr Fothergill's in the UK. Supplier of flower & vegetable seeds and plants, with one of the UK's most extensive seed ranges. Family-owned, proudly independent.

feeds.title: RCHS » Veg Growing
feeds.description: The Royal Caledonian Horticultural Society (The Caley) is Scotland's national horticultural and gardening society. Members include both amateur and professional, generalists, specialists and many others who simply like gardens and gardening. They aim to encourage and improve the science, art and practice of all types of horticulture and to advance education in gardening and horticulture for everyone.

feeds.title: Sow, Grow, Harvest
feeds.description: Tracey Everett is a backyard garden enthusiast passionate about growing and nurturing vegetables in her house. Join her adventures as she documents her gardening journey through countless ideas, photos, and top tips aimed at fellow readers to learn and make the most of their green surroundings.

feeds.title: Vertical Veg Blog
feeds.description: Vertical Veg talks about Container gardener. Inspired by how urban food growing improves wellbeing, brings people together and greens cities.

feeds.title: SimplySeed Blog
feeds.description: Grow your own veg - buy quality vegetable seeds online from SimplySeed.co.uk. We select the best seed varieties - so you don't have to.

feeds.title: The Culinary Herb Company
feeds.description: The Culinary Herb Company is a herb nursery producing over 200 varieties of culinary and medicinal herbs, perpetual salads, vegetable plants & edible flowers. Specialist herb plant nursery, 250+ varieties of potted herbs, perpetual salads, edible flowers and vegetable plants. Fennel, Angelica, Artichoke and more.

feeds.title: Lets Grow Cook
feeds.description: From when to grow vegetables & what vegetables to grow, this is our treasure chest of growing content. Vegetable growing planners & top veggie growing tips

feeds.title: Grown Local Blog
feeds.description: From microgreen trays to vegetable seeds, Grown Local equips you with everything needed to kickstart your gardening journey. Let's grow together!

feeds.title: Mark's Veg Plot
feeds.description: Mark is Trying to narrow the gap between Gardeners and Foodies. Long-time veggie gardener, keen cook, enthused with photography and blogging.

feeds.title: Urban Turnip
feeds.description: Urban Turnip is a blog about urban gardening, with an emphasis on growing in pots and containers. This is a simple resource that brings practical, time-tested growing techniques to the city setting. The site covers all the forms of gardening - indoors, in containers, in small spaces, vertical, hydroponic - that are applicable to city-dwellers who want to grow their own food.

feeds.title: Incredible Vegetables Blog
feeds.description: Mandy Barber grows, sells and researches perennial vegetables. I grow, dream, eat, write, talk about veg!

feeds.title: The Urban Veg Patch
feeds.description: Caro a writer, gardener, and photographer of the Urban Veg Patch... and beyond! In this blog they write about what they have grown in those spaces, lessons learned and mistakes made. You'll also find reviews of the latest books and products here.

feeds.title: The Allotment Garden » Fruit & Vegetable Gardening
feeds.description: The Allotment Garden shares Top organic tips, views & news for the flower & veg gardener. They are a collection of guides to growing your own vegetables - offering advice and tips on everything organic allotment gardening.

feeds.title: Vegepod Blog
feeds.description: Read Vegepod Blog for the Latest News And Updates and browse our articles on all sorts of topics such as strawberry planting, slowing growth rates and planting seedlings. Supplying the best raised garden bed on the market to gardeners of all abilities in the United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Seed Parade
feeds.description: Seed Parade have a wide range of heirloom, traditional and rare vegetable, herb and flower seed varieties for you to grow in your garden and allotment. Whether you are looking to grow tasty food for the table, or a colourful and scented garden we have the right varieties, all suitable to grow in the UK.

feeds.title: Quickcrop Blog
feeds.description: Quickcrop is all about making vegetable growing easy and accessible whether you live in the countryside or the city, whether you want to grow a pot of salad leaves or want to feed your whole family. This is a Vegetable growers blog full of gardening articles, tips and tricks for growing your own vegetables.

feeds.title: Real Men Sow Blog
feeds.description: Follow us to keep up with articles on Vegetable Gardening. Real Men Sow has been named as one of Dobbie's favourite allotment blogs, and a recommended site by the Daily Mail.
